execution.name: h1_mission_counterexample
execution.scope: actual MissionController and RouteProgress, injected optional witness

claims.scope_result: Source supports the local mechanism: mission progress requires measured crossing plus current matching continuation unless a narrow exception applies; every mission update replaces the previous sample. However onNavigationCommand immediately calls updateMission for an accepted continuation and rechecks command/state/health/identity, so a timer-only delay assertion is overstated. Exact producer-to-admission candidate timing under real geometry/tracking gates is not reproduced.
claims.negative_control: Current matching witness crossing advances once; wrong request identity does not; late witness after the crossing segment has moved outside the acceptance region does not reconstruct the old segment.
claims.reachability: LOCAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE using production MissionController/RouteProgress; upstream continuation is injected, so not PRODUCT_PATH_REACHABLE for a specific candidate.

execution.name: execution_episode_suspension_assertions
execution.scope: runtime lifecycle helper only; no PX4 adapter or transport

claims.scope_result: Static source path is supported under explicit timing/state/health premises: stale world suspends exact runtime bundle with no command; exact-generation recertification may restore it; otherwise PX4 adapter independently expires its last accepted command and latches safety stop/handover. This is a fail-closed terminal outcome, not proof of a liveness defect. Actual lease timing and PX4 acceptance are unobserved.
claims.negative_control: Fresh world recertifies before the adapter lease and passes exact identity/world/state checks; adapter has a narrow exact-identity exception only for a completed command during its bounded recovery interval, not ordinary MAIN.
claims.reachability: PRODUCT_PATH_REACHABLE statically conditional on no useful recertified command reaching the adapter before its configured/constructor-validated lease and on other adapter inputs remaining admissible.

claims.claim: The configured candidate governor can exclude a feasible lower-speed/duration candidate, or its pre-optimizer work materially consumes solve budget.

claims.scope_result: A has a descending 16-sample speed grid. It checks actual measured PVAJ under BACKUP physical limits, then checks proposed steady cruise candidates. Failed governor result returns before nominal endpoint MINCO in this caller. A separate route gate requires partial support greater than 2*resolution (0.4 m at the reviewed default resolution). Duration selection returns the first dynamically feasible seed before the caller checks support. No reachable product false negative or material cost was established.
claims.negative_control: Positive concrete-stop fixture and missing-support rejection. Audit sweep tests 24 zero-PVAJ/helper input combinations at support 0.401–5 m and requested speed 1–8 m/s; no case rejected by the grid had a feasible 1 m/s-resolution sweep witness. Same production stopping certificate is the oracle, so this is a helper-local comparison, not an independent mathematical proof or product path.
claims.reachability: LOCAL_COUNTEREXAMPLE not found in the stated helper domain; no actual route/world/candidate fixture was constructed.

claims.claim: `Success` from PX4 `scheduleMode(AUTO_LOITER)` clears retry before `VehicleStatus.AUTO_LOITER` confirmation, but dependency semantics and callback ordering decide whether that is an actual liveness defect.
premises_to_confirm: exact linked/submodule PX4 ROS 2 interface revision
meaning and dispatch order of Success/Deactivated/Failure

counterevidence_or_narrowing: Success may guarantee operation completion or accepted mode transition
Deactivated may explicitly transfer authority to operator
status may arrive before API callback
unconditional retry may reassert mode after operator takeover
test_plan: read exact dependency source pinned by A and inspect build linkage
only run controlled native/API fixture if the actual API dispatch can be isolated
claims.scope_result: The pinned ModeExecutor callback is not merely a VehicleCommand ACK: it waits for matching ModeCompleted after scheduled-mode activation. Therefore any previous phrasing that Success is only an ACK and may stop retry is REFUTED. App still clears pending on Success/Deactivated independently of VehicleStatus AUTO_LOITER; exact callback/status ordering and PX4 mode-result semantics are unresolved without matching firmware/runtime evidence. Deactivated is treated as authority loss and not retried to avoid taking control from an operator.

subclaims.claim: scheduleMode Success means command ACK only
Success/VehicleStatus AUTO_LOITER ordering can leave a persistent unconfirmed state
